description: Preview one-time price changes for the connected owner's RAW, graded, or all sports, non-sports and TCG cards. Choose AT_MARKET, PREMIUM (above market) or MOVE_FAST, or omit strategy to use the store setting. Choose increases, decreases, or either direction. Uses condition/grade-specific market guidance and existing price limits. Returns exact proposals, skipped reasons and a SuperCatch review URL. Does not change prices, settings or automation enrollment. The seller must review and confirm batches in SuperCatch. Continue with nextCursor and the same selection to inspect all cards.

automationMode.description: Prepare OFF, recommendations, or automatically applied ongoing repricing. Does not change settings until confirmed in SuperCatch.

cardType.description: Review RAW, graded/authenticated, or all active in-stock card copies in the connected store.

cursor.description: Continue with nextCursor from the previous page, keeping the same selection.

direction.description: Filter one-time price changes. Ongoing repricing requires ANY; publishing includes all displayed cards.

integrationId.description: Choose an enabled connection ID returned in publishing.targets for this store. The seller confirms the exact account before a normal export job is queued.

strategy.description: AT_MARKET, PREMIUM (above market), or MOVE_FAST. Omit to use the existing store strategy. Confirmed automation uses this as store-wide strategy.
